For over 60 years, AKTG has been offering tailor-made trips for the most discerning travelers of our travel agent and tour operator partners. We operate across five continents, with over 40 destinations where we have our own offices and teams. Under the A&K Sanctuary brand, we also own 13 intimate, high-end lodges in sub-Saharan Africa, five luxury boats on the Nile, and a 12-suite boat in the Peruvian Amazon. Finally, our Paris office provides close support to our Belgian partners, including regular sales visits!

UPAV’s mission is to represent and defend travel agencies, and to promote and enhance the value of the travel agent profession. This ambition takes the form of innovative projects, group or on-demand training, coaching, telephone assistance, a weekly newsletter, regular meetings at UPAV breakfasts and lunches, an annual congress and many other benefits. Further information and membership application form at www.upav.be
